# Pristine Clean & Shine

> Commercial cleaning company based in Northwood, HA6, North West London. Regular contract cleaning for offices, shops and retail units, churches, church halls and community halls, and the communal areas of blocks of flats, plus deep cleans and end of tenancy cleans. Fully insured. Every job is priced individually after a free quote and free site visit.

- Company: PRISTINECLEANANDSHINE LTD, trading as Pristine Clean & Shine, company number 16100576, registered in England and Wales
- Based in: Northwood, HA6
- Areas covered: Northwood, Ruislip, Pinner, Eastcote, Harrow, Rickmansworth, Watford, North West London, London, Hertfordshire, Surrey, Berkshire and Buckinghamshire
- Registered on the Central Digital Platform (PPON) for public sector work
- Not VAT registered
- Contact: info@pristinecleanandshine.co.uk, 07495 595 695
- Request a free quote: https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/contact.html

## Services

- [Office cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/office-cleaning.html): regular office cleaning before, during or after working hours
- [Shop and retail cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/retail-cleaning.html): shops and retail units cleaned around opening hours
- [Church and community hall cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/church-and-community-hall-cleaning.html): churches, church halls and community halls cleaned around bookings
- [Communal area cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/communal-area-cleaning.html): stairwells, corridors, entrances and bin stores in blocks of flats
- [Deep cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/deep-cleaning.html): top-to-bottom cleans, including kitchens and washrooms
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://www.pristinecleanandshine.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning.html): for landlords, letting agents, housing associations, tenants and commercial units
